content.short: XMTP is a messaging protocol facilitating decentralized communication for Web3.
content.description: XMTP provides a decentralized messaging approach that removes centralized ownership of profiles and content in online communications, aligning with a web3 ethos. Users can talk across apps using their wallet addresses, enabling a consistent wallet‑based identity across the ecosystem and reducing friction between services. For developers, XMTP offers a JavaScript SDK to build chat platforms and host them on EVM networks, supporting interoperable conversations across different apps without reliance on a central service or provider.
